dataset: NASA PCoE C-MAPSS FD001-FD004 pooled XGBoost RUL model

selection_rationale.selection_metric: mean macro-subset MAE across three engine-level validation splits; macro-subset RMSE as corroborating metric; NASA-style asymmetric score reported as a trade-off
selection_rationale.note: Cap 250 had the lowest macro-subset MAE on each of the three repeated validation splits. Cap 350 had the lowest mean NASA-style score, so the selected configuration reflects an explicit MAE-first decision, not a universal win on every metric.
selection_rationale.official_test_note: Official test labels/results were inspected earlier in project development; any official-test numbers are exploratory benchmark results, not a pristine blind test.
